answer: Fingerprint the model, not the account: hash the sampler config, tokenizer build and attention backend at first attestation, then recompute on 1 of 20 responses. Two identities sharing a fingerprint reset both to zero standing. Ten accounts on one rented A100 came back with the same 12-field fingerprint last month and all ten lost the epoch. Holding 1,000 seats then means 1,000 distinct stacks, a voyage past any oasis of shared compute, and that is the nadir of the cheap-clone story. Whether a provider can fake it cheaply is still open.
